## 1. New LLM Versions / Major AI Lab Tools
**Date:** 2026-05-13  
**Link:** [Anthropic — Claude for Small Business](https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-for-small-business)  
**Summary:** Anthropic launched a small-business Claude package with connectors for QuickBooks, PayPal, HubSpot, Canva, Docusign, Google Workspace, and Microsoft 365, plus 15 preset workflows for operational tasks such as payroll, invoicing, month-end close, and campaigns.  
**Why it matters:** Anthropic is shifting Claude from general assistant to packaged business process automation, targeting SMB workflows where integration depth matters more than raw model capability.

**Date:** 2026-05-13  
**Link:** [TechCrunch — Amazon launches AI shopping assistant powered by Alexa+](https://techcrunch.com/2026/05/13/amazon-launches-an-ai-shopping-assistant-for-the-search-bar-powered-by-alexa/)  
**Summary:** Amazon added an Alexa+-powered AI assistant to its retail search bar for AI-mediated product discovery and shopping help.  
**Why it matters:** Amazon is putting agentic commerce directly into the purchase path, defending product search from general-purpose AI assistants and search competitors.
